notes: The marketplace layer of eCrime: where stolen data, access, and contraband are sold. Historically takedown-prone (Silk Road, AlphaBay) but continuously reborn - the persistent-market pattern.

entities.name: Darknet_Market
entities.notes: Tor-hosted marketplace class: stolen data, initial access, credentials, drugs, contraband, escrow + reputation. Structurally resilient - takedowns kill instances, not the model.

entities.name: Nexus_Darkweb
entities.notes: Dark-web data-exfiltration service (advertised on the Russian forum Exploit, Aug 2026) claiming continuous near-real-time access to a breached identity-verification pipeline (~500k docs/day). The data-as-a-service mutation of the market.

entities.name: Silk_Road
entities.notes: The original Tor drug market (2011-13). Founder Ross Ulbricht convicted 2015 (life; pardoned Jan 2025) - the case that defined darknet-market prosecution.

entities.name: AlphaBay
entities.notes: Largest darknet market at its peak; seized in Operation Bayonet (2017), a coordinated US/EU takedown that funneled users into the honeypotted Hansa market.

entities.name: IABs
entities.notes: Initial Access Brokers: criminals who breach networks and resell the foothold (RDP, VPN, webshell, valid creds) to ransomware crews - the wholesale tier that industrialized eCrime and feeds the darknet-market economy.
